svg.title: Where the track is today
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon loop map of today. The Gate and Router are tall wooden checkpoints spanning both routes. Past the router, Rust track runs beside the old dirt road on the way out and on the way back. Customs is a finished Rust station built over the outbound track. Cache, Vault and Post office have construction outlines on the track while their old wooden huts still do the work off to the side; the Ledger is wooden. A train tagged OCR is stopped at the Cache unloading onto a wagon, and another is stopped at the Post office on the way back. After the stations the OCR line is Rust track, Messages is opt-in Rust track, and Responses and Chat are still dirt roads.
svg.text: Rust track runs past the router, but most stations are still Python, so the train stops and unloads at each one.
